author: DaiqingChen
body:
Two transmembrane collagen and Collagen type XXVII trimers have no annotations, grouping them into one ticket.

The three terms are Collagen type XXIII trimer (GO:1990322), Collagen type XXV trimer (GO:1990327) and Collagen type XVII trimer (GO:0030937).

* **Collagen type XXIII trimer (GO:1990322)**:
There is no annotation for this term.
Add gene products to term for human and mouse:
 - [x] COL23A1: Hs:[Q86Y22](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q86Y22/entry); Mm:[Q8K4G2](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8K4G2/entry); PMID:21421911.

* **Collagen type XXV trimer (GO:1990327)**:
There is no annotation for this term.
Add gene products to term for human and mouse:
 - [x] COL25A1: Hs:[Q9BXS0](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9BXS0/entry); Mm:[Q99MQ5](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q99MQ5/entry); PMID:21421911.

* **Collagen type XVII trimer (GO:0030937)**:
There is no annotation for this term.
Add gene products to term for human and mouse:
 - [x] COL27A1: Hs:[Q8IZC6](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8IZC6/entry); Mm:[Q5QNQ9](https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q5QNQ9/entry); PMID:21421911.
title: New annotations for transmembrane and type XXVII collagens
